draftContext.markdown:
The October 31 editorial train is blocked at the independent review stage (daily-logger #515). The review has been open for two days with no movement. The dependency on issue #516 (pipeline failure) or a human gate is not established; this requires direct inspection before the train can advance to correction.

Issue #516 cause is unknown from available evidence. The failed run URL is https://github.com/ojfbot/daily-logger/actions/runs/41267355441. The right triage path — /disable, /enable, or targeted fix — depends on the failure mode (auth expiry, cron misconfiguration, downstream API error). This is the highest-priority open question for pipeline health.

The bounded backfill reference procedure (set ACTION_REVIEW_DISABLED repo variable → dispatch with date_override → remove variable after job start) is now on main via PR #517. No additional action is required for past backfills; this procedure is the reference for future runs.

workstation-yuri review cadence: seven draft PRs await structured review findings. No named reviewer or schedule is documented in available evidence. Owner gate required to establish sequence.

classic-space-venue #4 and morning-cockpit #60 are non-draft PRs open since October 21 with no disposition. These are candidates for explicit close, park, or active-work decisions.

lego-village-pipeline #44, #45, #46 and classic-space-venue #8 are stale drafts ranging from October 11–23 with no movement or disposition. Whether these represent intentional parking or accumulating drag is not determinable from available evidence.
